// Table inputs: Copyright 2009 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// See Go-LICENSE. Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-27.
// Inputs: Go 1.27.3 src/strconv/quote_test.go unquotetests and misquoted.
// Expectations: actual pinned Loki Scanner plus vendored strutil.Unquote,
// not Go strconv.Unquote or Pulse. Local controls are separately marked.
// Reproduction setup, source hashes and decoder adaptations: README.md.
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"pulse-string-oracle/strutil"
	"pulse-string-oracle/syntax"
)

type row struct {
	Source  string  `json:"source"`
	Literal string  `json:"literal_base64"`
	Value   *string `json:"value_base64"`
}

func decode(literal string) *string {
	s := syntax.Scanner{}
	s.Init(strings.NewReader(literal))
	s.Error = func(*syntax.Scanner, string) {}
	tok := s.Scan()
	text := s.TokenText()
	if tok != syntax.String && tok != syntax.RawString || !utf8.ValidString(text) {
		return nil
	}
	value, err := strutil.Unquote(text)
	if err != nil || s.Scan() != syntax.EOF || s.ErrorCount != 0 {
		return nil
	}
	encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(value))
	return &encoded
}

func main() {
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), os.Args[1], nil, 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	emit := func(source, literal string) {
		if err := enc.Encode(row{source, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(literal)), decode(literal)}); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
	counts := map[string]int{}
	ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		decl, ok := n.(*ast.ValueSpec)
		if !ok || len(decl.Names) != 1 {
			return true
		}
		name := decl.Names[0].Name
		if name != "unquotetests" && name != "misquoted" {
			return true
		}
		for _, item := range decl.Values[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			if name == "unquotetests" {
				item = item.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts[0]
			}
			literal, err := strconv.Unquote(item.(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			emit(name, literal)
			counts[name]++
		}
		return false
	})
	if counts["unquotetests"] != 35 || counts["misquoted"] != 28 {
		panic("unexpected original Go table counts")
	}
	for _, literal := range []string{
		`"\000"`, `"\0"`, `"\00"`, `"\0000"`, `"\400"`, `"\777"`, `"\378"`,
		`"\x00"`, `"\xC3\xBF"`, `"\200"`, `"\xc0\xaf"`, `"\x001"`, `"\x1"`, `"\xGG"`,
		`"\d"`, `"\w"`, `"\s"`, `"\q"`, `"\uD800"`, `"\U0000DFFF"`, `"\U0010ffff"`, `"\U00110000"`,
		`"\u12"`, `"\U0000000"`, `"\uGGGG"`, `"\"`, "\"a\x00b\"", "`a\x00b`", "\"a\rb\"", "`a\r\nb`",
		"\"\xc0\xaf\"", "`\xff`", `"#//"`, "`\\a\\000\\xFF\\uD800`", `"é😀"`, `"\u00ff"`,
		`"\U7fffffff"`, `"\U80000000"`, `"\U8000007f"`, `"\U80000080"`, `"\Uffffffff"`,
	} {
		emit("local", literal)
	}
}
